regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow: only 5 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate, and the top momentum names (Diversified Miners) are not even gate-eligible, so the only clean headroom sits in High-Dividend Blue Chips, Banks, Conglomerates, Energy (H-shares), and Tech Hardware. The regime is not one-narrative — leadership is contested between a trend-y Miners leader and a broader dividend/income challenger — and the macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics/AI headlines with a very high unscheduled-share, so this is a flow-focus lens, not a return signal.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Diversified Miners — the top momentum leader but currently gate-INELIGIBLE (durability_bar 0.42) — achieves gate eligibility with durability above 0.5. If it does, the leadership becomes a confirmed non-narrowing handoff from dividend/income toward resources; if it stays ineligible for another 6 weeks, the watch retires and the dividend/energy cluster remains the only trend-worthy leadership.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: This is the only top-ranked theme that is gate-eligible AND has the strongest durability_bar (0.83) with full breadth (1.0) and a clean trend hurst tag. The detector's validated edge is staying power/drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate, and High-Dividend Blue Chips passes it while the top momentum leader (Miners) does not. I lean with the gate-eligible, high-durability name rather than the momentum leader, consistent with discipline-not-prediction.
theses.dissent: The cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so the high score confers no alpha; and as an income/defensive theme it may lag if a broad risk-on rally in growth/tech resumes.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips breadth drops below 0.6 or durability_bar falls under 0.5 before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is gate-eligible with a very high durability_bar (0.81), trend hurst tag, and 0.9 breadth — a coherent, trend-y income/resource complex that passes the one validated risk-control leg. It sits just below the dividend/bank cluster and is not crowded, so it is a reasonable second gate-eligible lean rather than reaching for the ineligible momentum leader.
theses.dissent: Macro headlines show only 3 energy mentions against 28 geopolitics and 25 AI — attention is not on energy, and the energy theme could be a laggard if the AI/geopolitics narrative dominates flows.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) durability_bar breaks below 0.5 or breadth falls under 0.5.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the worst-ranked gate-ineligible scorable theme (score -0.647, durability 0.14, mean-revert hurst, breadth 0.158). It fails the ONE validated edge (absolute-trend gate) and has no trend health. With a track record showing high directional accuracy on prior calls, avoid is the honest lean for a name that is not even eligible for the staying-power leg.
theses.dissent: As a mean-reverting name it could bounce hardest if the macro AI/tech narrative (25 mentions) suddenly turns risk-on; avoid is a relative-strength call, not a return forecast.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet becomes gate-eligible and its durability_bar clears 0.5 with breadth above 0.5.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
